content.short: AI-generated Art NFT Marketplace - image morphing and video deepfakes.
content.description:
Upload a profile picture of yourself, morph it and deepfake it via AI, then mint as an NFT on Cardano. Auto-post on social media, and promote your AI-generated artwork on the TaChiKu marketplace. TaChiKu was funded by Catalyst in Fund7. It is accessible as a web dApp providing AI morphing and NFT minting capabilities.

Our roadmap provides for a fully decentralised AI ecosystem with more ready-to-use AI engines, from still images to video.
